metadata.question: Are more brown/orange areas visible in the Adirondack Mountains on October 8, 2022, than on October 1, 2022?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare "brown/orange areas" in the Adirondack Mountains between October 8, 2022 and October 1, 2022. Brown/orange areas likely refer to autumn foliage changes. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for high-resolution visible bands 2. Define the Adirondack Mountains region (I'll use a rough polygon) 3. Get images for both specific dates 4. Calculate a vegetation index or color ratio that detects brown/orange foliage 5. Compare the extent of these areas between the two dates For detecting brown/orange areas, I can use: - A brown index: (B04 - B03) / (B04 + B03) where B04 is red and B03 is green - Or focus on red/orange reflectance using B04 (red band) - Higher values would indicate more brown/orange areas I need to: - Check if images exist for both dates (if not, output C1) - Count pixels above a threshold for brown/orange detection - Compare the counts between the two dates - Handle cloud masking ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const adirondacks = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-74.5, 44.0], [-73.5, 44.0], [-73.5, 43.5], [-74.5, 43.5], [-74.5, 44.0] ]); const date1 = '2022-10-01'; const date2 = '2022-10-08'; // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate brown/orange index (higher values = more brown/orange) function calcBrownIndex(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B04', 'B03']).rename('brown_index'); // (Red - Green)/(Red + Green) } // 2. Data Acquisition const s2_col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2Clouds); const s2_col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(adirondacks) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2Clouds); const size1 = s2_col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = s2_col2.size().getInfo(); print(`Oct 1 Images: ${size1}, Oct 8 Images: ${size2}`); // Check for empty collections if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get first (least cloudy) images const img1 = s2_col1.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const img2 = s2_col2.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Calculate brown indices const brown1 = calcBrownIndex(img1); const brown2 = calcBrownIndex(img2); // Count pixels with brown_index > 0.1 (brown/orange areas) const brownMask1 = brown1.gt(0.1); const brownMask2 = brown2.gt(0.1); // Get pixel counts const count1 = brownMask1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: adirondacks, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('brown_index').getInfo(); const count2 = brownMask2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: adirondacks, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('brown_index').getInfo(); print(`Oct 1 brown pixels: ${count1}, Oct 8 brown pixels: ${count2}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for invalid results if (count1 === null || count2 === null || isNaN(count1) || isNaN(count2)) { print("C3"); return; } // Compare and output answer const percentChange = ((count2 - count1) / count1 * 100).toFixed(1); print(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (count2 > count1) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
